description: Full-text search across the paragraphs of every in-force Estonian act (4M+ sections). Answers 'which provision governs X' directly, returning the paragraphs themselves rather than acts you then have to read. Each hit carries a `section:` id for `fetch`.

query.description: A legal term or phrase, e.g. 'pankrotiavaldus', 'ehitusluba', 'töölepingu ülesütlemine'.

name: search_law_sections
title: Search the text of Estonian legislation, paragraph by paragraph
